context:
Goal: the batch runner merges a batch that carries the fix for red main without your yes each time.
Problem (rule): #3097, which you said to merge at 23:42 CST, is red because it puts a merge allow rule in settings.json, which main's tests forbid, and the real cause of the 23:18 CST refusal was the command's shape, so moving the rule may fix nothing.
Based on (read): runner 10's transcript at 23:18 CST: the refused merge was one Bash call with a pipe, `;` parts, a variable and a redirect, and the Claude Code safety check refused it; main's merge/cloud_allow.json already allows `~/.claude/bin/merge * --confirm *`, which matches the merge typed alone with --base-red-ok.
Based on (read): #3097's run 43375520417 fails test_the_repo_settings_json_has_no_merge_allow_rule; on main, merge allow rules live only in merge/cloud_allow.json, which only cloud sessions install.
Based on (ruling): your Cockpit pick 178 a (2026-11-03 22:31 CST): Claude may use the red-main flag, with a logged reason, only for the batch that carries the fix.
Departs from: main's batch runner waits for your yes on each red-main merge — a red-main fix batch merges with no yes: by a bare command (a), a copied cloud rule (b), or a rule for local sessions too (c).
Why yours: you said to merge #3097 as is; closing it or moving its rule changes that word.
home: decision auto-mode-owner-acts; decision session-tiers (cloud merge rules)

options.gain: No new allow rule anywhere; the rule main already has covers it, local sessions keep asking, and the tests stay as they are.
options.how: Runner 10 closes #3097 and runs each red-main merge as a Bash call of its own: `~/.claude/bin/merge <pr> --confirm --head <sha> --base-red-ok "<reason>"`, with no pipe, `;`, variable or redirect. Triage files a step so the batch runner's instructions say so. The next red-main fix batch is the test.
options.label: Close #3097; the batch runner types the merge as one bare command (recommended)
options.lose: Untested: if the bare call is still refused, the next red-main fix batch needs your yes again, and this question comes back.

options.gain: Local sessions keep asking; the placement test stays.
options.how: #3097's lane moves the rule and re-runs CI; runner 10 batches it.
options.label: Move #3097's rule into merge/cloud_allow.json
options.lose: The file already has a rule that matches this merge, so the copy likely fixes nothing for a call with pipes or redirects.

options.gain: Local sessions also skip the ask on a red-main merge.
options.how: #3097's lane re-points the placement test; runner 10 batches it.
options.label: Keep the rule in settings.json and re-point the test
options.lose: Drops main's rule that a local session never auto-allows a merge command; may still miss calls with pipes or redirects.
